notes.title: Santo Island Incident | Announcement
notes.content:
MYSTERY - EXPLORING - PUZZLE - Overgrowth took over the whole Santo Island and facility as a result of an unknown incident. Your mission is to find out the source of the incident and solve what's happened at Santo Island.

[h3][b]Add to your Wishlist now:[/b][/h3]

notes.content:

-Doors now has visible field.


New gameplay feature, you can now rotate object while holding magnetic cube on your hand.

notes.title: Quality Update to Version 1.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone this update significantly improve gameplay quality of game. Please be sure have version 1.1 of game.

-Gameplay precision update
-FOV added

If you experience any additional issues, or have suggestions for me, please let me know in the Discussion Forums, or feel free to contact me via twitter: https://twitter.com/OrangeCinar

Thank you, and have a lovely weekend!
